senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (दलति) r. 10th cl. (दालयति)
1 To cut, to divide, to split or pierce.
2 To be cut, &c.
3 To display.
4 To wither.

mn. (-लः-लं)
A leaf.
n. (-लं)
1 A part, a portion, a fragment.
2 Dividing, tearing, cutting, splitting, &c.
3 A sheath, a scabbard.
4 An adulteration or alloy.
5 A heap or quantity.
6 The leaf of the Tamāla.
7 A half.
E.
दल to divide, to cut, &c. affix अच्.

n. (-लं)
Wild or unprepared honey.
m. (-लः)
A sort of grain, (Paspalum frumentaceum.)
f. (-ला)
Colocynth.
E.
दल a sheath, affix अण्.

m. (-टः)
A folded petal or leaf.
E.
दल, and कपाट a door.

m. (-षः)
A sort of jasmine, (J. pubescens.)
E.
दल, a leaf, and कोष a sheath.

mfn. (-लन्-लन्ती-लत्)
1 Splitting, rending.
2 Being torn or cut.
E.
दल to cut or be pierced, affix शतृ.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Broken-hearted, cut to the heart, &c.
E.
दलत्, and हृदय the heart.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Breaking to pieces, cutting, dividing, (who or what does so.)
n. (-नं)
Tearing, rending, breaking, pulling to pieces.
f. (-नी)
A clod or clump of earth or mould.
E.
दल to divide, affix ल्युट्.

n. (-नं)
Toothache.
E.
दल to tear, causal v., ल्युट् aff.

m. (-कः)
The Bhojpatra, a tree of which the bark is used for hookah snakes, &c.
E.
दल a leaf, and निर्म्भोक shedding, casting off.

m. (-पः)
1 Gold.
2 A sacred or religious institute.
E.
दल to be divided, Uṇādi affix अप.

f. (-ष्पी)
A fragrant plant, (Pandanus odoratissimus.)
E.
दल a leaf, and पुष्प a flower; the leaves surrounding the flower.

m. (-चिः)
A thorn.
E.
दल a leaf, and सूचि a needle.

f. (-सा)
The fibre or vein of a leaf.
E.
दल a leaf, and स्नसा a fibre.

m. (-कः)
1 Sesamum growing wild or spontaneously.
2 An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes.)
3 A plant commonly Nagesara, (Mesua ferrea.)
4 A tree, (Mimosa sirisha^1.)
5 Red chalk.
6 Cuttle fish bone.
7 A moat, a ditch.
8 A sort of jasmine, (J. pubescens.)
9 An elephant's ear.
10 The driver of an elephant.
11 A hurricane, a high wind.
E.
दल as above, ढौकृ to go, with आङ् prefixed, affix अच्, deriv. irr.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

m. (-ढ्यः)
Mud, but mud especially on the banks of a river.

n. (-लं)
1 A tree, (Vangueria spinosa): see मरुवक.
2 A plant, (Artemisia.)
E.
दल a leaf, and अमल clear, clean.

n. (-म्लं)
Sorrel.
E.
दल the leaf, and अम्ल sour.

mf. (-लिः-ली)
A clod of clay or mould.
E.
दल to be divided, (by the harrow or plough,) Uṇādi affix इ.

m. (-कः)
Timber, wood.
E.
दल to split, affix इकच्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Blown, full blown, expanded.
2 Broken, split.
3 Cut to pieces.
4 Torn, rent.
5 Scattered, driven apart, divided.
6 Opened, unfolded.
E.
दल to split, affix क्त.

m. (-न्धिः)
A plant, (Echites scholaris): see सप्तपर्ण.
E.
दल in the seventh case दले, in the leaf, and गन्धि fragrance.

m. (-ल्भः)
1 Fraud, dishonesty.
2 Sin.
3 The name of a Muni or saint.
4 A wheel.
E.
दल to divide, भ Uṇādi aff.

m. (-ल्भिः)
A name of INDRA.
2 INDRA'S thunderbolt.
E.
दल to break or split, Uṇādi affix भि.

m. (-बः)
A sort of poison.
E.
दल to tear, in the causal form, अच् affix, and ब added.

m. (-मः)
The pomegranate: see दाडिम.

m. (-ल्मिः)
A name of INDRA.
E.
दल to tear or split, (mountains,) मिन् aff.
